Hi Ana — great to meet today. Thanks for the time and for walking through Acme's evaluation priorities.

Recap / success criteria (as we discussed):
- Latency: 99th percentile inference latency <= 300ms for interactive workflows (avg seq length ~120 tokens)
- Cost: Target token cost <= $0.003/token for batch scoring workload (50k requests/day)
- Quality: >= 92% pass rate on your 200-case safety & correctness prompt set (sheet attached)
- Integration: API key-based integration + SSO for internal users; ability to pin model version during POC

Evaluation plan & timeline:
- Week 0 (this week): access + baseline test vectors uploaded by your team
- Week 1: integration + initial smoke tests (ours to support)
- Week 2: run eval harness; iterate on prompt and model config
- Week 3: joint review, decision on expansion/scale

Ownership:
- Acme: Ana Lopez (evaluation lead), Procurement for contracting
- Redwood: Marissa Cole (primary), Rishi Malhotra (ops escalation)

Immediate next steps I can action this week:
1) Provision API key + temporary credentials for your dev team
2) Send SSO invites to acme.com users (requires admin approval on your side)
3) Provide IP allowlist ranges to your infra team and confirm outbound firewall rules

Please reply with the list of emails to invite for SSO and the IP ranges to allow. I attached the POC-eval-plan.xlsx with the evaluation test cases and timelines.

Thanks — I’ll aim to get credentials to you within 24 business hours once you confirm the allowlist.
